tools.name: search_social_services
tools.description: Search for social support services (Angebote) and facilities (Einrichtungen) across the Federated Data Pool by category, locality, postal code, target audience, provider organization, language, and accessibility attributes.

category.description: Service category or German welfare classification (e.g., 'Jugendberatung', 'Schuldnerberatung', 'Suchtberatung', 'Frauenhaus').

language.description: Language code or name supported by the service (e.g., 'tr', 'ar', 'uk', 'DGS', 'Amharic').

has_email.description: Filter for facilities that have a verified contact email address.

anonymous.description: Filter for services offering anonymous intake or consultation.

include_sublocalities.description: Include sub-districts (Ortsteile) within a broader Bezirk.

time.description: Requested service time in HH:MM format (e.g., '03:00') to filter by opening hours.

facility_name.description: Specific facility name or substring to match.

tools.name: find_nearby_services
tools.description: Geospatial proximity search for social support facilities and services using coordinates (latitude/longitude), postal code, or landmark/locality within a specified radius.

postcode.description: 5-digit German postal code / PLZ for proximity center.

tools.name: get_facility_details
tools.description: Retrieve comprehensive metadata, contact details, address, opening hours, parent Träger, and linked services for a specific facility (Einrichtung) by IRI or name.

facility_name.description: Exact or partial name of the facility (schema:name or schema:alternateName).

tools.name: inspect_data_quality
tools.description: Audit the Federated Data Pool schemas (einrichtungSchema, angebotSchema, adresseSchema, traegerSchema) for missing contact fields, orphaned foreign keys, or invalid geographic bounding boxes.

missing_fields.description: List of fields to check for null/missing values (e.g., ['phone', 'email', 'opening_hours']).

check_orphans.description: If true, detect Angebot records whose schema:provider IRI does not exist in einrichtungSchema.

check_bbox.description: If true, detect Adresse records with latitude/longitude outside the Berlin bounding box.

tools.name: sparql_query
tools.description: Execute a read-only SPARQL 1.1 SELECT/ASK/CONSTRUCT query against the Federated Data Pool RDF graph (directory.ttl). Enforces a 30s timeout and recommends explicit LIMIT clauses.

tools.name: check_opening_hours
tools.description: Check opening hours (schema:openingHours) for a facility and optionally verify if it is currently open.

tools.name: search_facility_by_postcode
tools.description: Search facilities located in a specific 5-digit postal code (schema:postalCode).

tools.name: analyze_coverage_gaps
tools.description: Analyze service category coverage gaps across postal codes or districts for a given provider.

tools.name: audit_and_repair_localities
tools.description: Audit and infer missing district/locality labels from 5-digit postal codes in adresseSchema.

tools.name: detect_duplicate_entities
tools.description: Detect duplicate facilities or cross-source entity overlaps across federated data providers.

tools.name: resolve_entity_hierarchy
tools.description: Resolve parent-child entity relationships (Angebot -> Einrichtung -> Träger) and optionally inherit missing contact/address properties.

tools.name: inspect_provenance_conflict
tools.description: Inspect conflicting attribute values across multiple federated data sources for a shared entity IRI.

tools.name: read_resource
tools.description: Read an MCP resource URI exposed by the server (e.g., sosuse://schema/categories).
